# Seven Nil

> Free browser game. Draft a historic World Cup or club XI, then simulate the tournament.

Seven Nil is not affiliated with FIFA or UEFA. Player ratings are for the season or tournament on the card, not a career peak.

## Play

- [World Cup draft](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/): roll a nation and a tournament year, pick one player, fill eleven roles.
- [Club draft](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/club): top five leagues from 1980.
- [Friends](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/friends): pass-and-play, a final, or a seeded cup.
- [Club friends](https://seven-nil-self.vercel.app/club/friends): rivalry or a UCL-style knockout.
